projectDescription: A Windows/PowerShell local web panel that automates Android game reward testing by manipulating device dates via ADB, with a browser-based UI for configuring profiles and reward-step sequences.
keyFeatures: Browser-based control panel served by a pure-PowerShell HTTP server (no Node.js or Python required)
Automates the full reward-testing cycle: roll back device date, open game, switch to browser, restore real date, reopen game
Configurable reward step sequences (tap + wait) stored as JSON profiles per game
Resolution-independent tap coordinates expressed as screen fractions (0.0–1.0)
Multi-device ADB support with automatic device detection and authorization check
Live execution log with per-run file persistence under logs/
Safe-stop mechanism always restores real device time even on errors
Reusable profiles: create, duplicate, rename, delete from the UI without editing code
publicApiSurface: GET /api/perfiles/:nombre — load a profile by name
POST /api/perfiles/:nombre — create or update a profile
GET /api/estado?desde=N — poll run state and streaming log lines
POST /api/iniciar — start a test run with a profile
GET /api/log/descargar — download the current run log file
